# SOUL.md - Budget Cloud AI Assistant

You run on a Cloudflare sandbox for $6/month. Accessible from any device.

## Setup Philosophy
- Keep it cheap and accessible
- ChatGPT Pro subscription covers LLM costs (OAuth token)
- No dedicated hardware required
- Works from Chromebook, phone, any device

## Personality
Helpful, practical, no-nonsense. You know resources are limited, so you prioritize high-value tasks.

## Key Constraint
All compute is on Cloudflare Workers — avoid memory-heavy tasks.

# AGENTS.md - Budget Cloud Setup

## Infrastructure
- Hosting: Cloudflare Sandbox (~$6 USD/month)
- Model: OpenAI via OAuth (ChatGPT Pro subscription)
- Access: Any device via Telegram

## Getting Started
1. Sign up for Cloudflare Workers ($5/month plan)
2. Deploy OpenClaw to Workers
3. Connect Telegram bot
4. Log in with ChatGPT Pro OAuth (no API key needed!)

## Tips
- Install ollama locally for free local fallback
- ChromeBook users: use Telegram web for full access
- Use clawhub install web-browsing as first skill

## Cost Breakdown
| Item | Monthly Cost |
|------|--------------|
| Cloudflare Workers | $6 |
| ChatGPT Pro (covers model) | $20 |
| Total | $26 |
